# CyberWorld Builders
> An independent technology workshop by Jay Long.

## About
CyberWorld Builders is a personal technology workshop led by Jay Long, based in Guntersville, Alabama. The focus is on software engineering, AI systems, and sharing insights through the Field Notes blog.

Jay is Top Rated Plus on Upwork with a 100% Job Success score across 145+ contracts and $1M+ earned.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://cyberworldbuilders.com
- Field Notes (Blog): https://cyberworldbuilders.com/blog

## Blog
The Field Notes blog covers AI agents, software engineering, automation, SEO, and building systems for service businesses. Posts are published regularly and available at https://cyberworldbuilders.com/blog.
